densityModel.screenPxPerMeter: H / (2 * d * tan(vfov / 2)) for a surface facing the camera at distance d
densityModel.magnification: screen px/m divided by texel px/m; above 1 the texture is magnified

screen.conditional: 1.5 < magnification <= 2.0 and not featureDefined; decided by the visual check, fallback one step up
screen.escalate: otherwise; try the next ladder step

densityModel.featureDefined: the surface reads through sharp periodic features (grout, mortar, board joints, weave, brushing); conditional magnification escalates
densityModel.gate: the screen chooses where qualification starts; the visual check in the representative scenes decides
densityModel.outOfScope: adaptive streaming, automatic quality, user texture preferences and anisotropic filtering

imageAdmission.colour: sRGB, no ICC/cICP other than standard sRGB

representativeScenes.description: Living room: herringbone floor, painted plaster walls, painted brick feature wall, walnut cabinet, linen sofa, leather chair, satin brass fittings, marble table top
Kitchen: tiled wall, terrazzo floor, oak veneer cabinets, brushed steel, matte plastic, painted plaster, concrete worktop
Gallery or office: oak plank floor, concrete and plaster walls, red brick, loop carpet, oak desk, leather chair, brushed fittings

inF: Remove all six from the creator-facing shelf and from catalogue counts; they become hidden legacy bases.
Keep every ID resolvable with unchanged recipe, pins and bytes, so saved projects, the S8 E0 baseline, goldens and fixtures that name them keep validating and rendering identically.
Re-point each creatorDefaults use to its qualified replacement; if the replacement fails qualification, that default stays on its legacy ID and the failure is recorded.
Leave internalUses unchanged in F (colour-overridden placeholder geometry and technical fallbacks).
Record each as a legacy placeholder with no catalogue provenance; never write a licence record or invent an origin for the three textured placeholders.
rules.afterF: Remove the six IDs, their five images and pins, and re-point internalUses, in one cleanup PR once no baseline needs them: strict Scene format bump, readers refuse, fixtures regenerated, no migration (pre-beta stance).

deferred.why: Velvet reads through sheen; v1 metallic-roughness renders it as flat cloth.
Coloured glaze with light grout needs a mask or layer; tint recolours grout too.
True brushed highlights need anisotropy; Core approximates with normals.
Opaque-only v1 has no alpha coverage.
v1 has no height; deep relief flattens to normals.
Layered blending and procedural wear are separate families.
